Camden Orange marks a special release: this year, we honored Orioles Hall of Fame inductees Chris Davis and Storm Davis, each presented with one of these watches to celebrate their induction into the 2026 Hall of Fame class. The color draws from Camden Yards itself, reflecting our continued partnership with Baltimore's home team. A domed sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating, Swiss Super-LumiNova X1 lume, and 200m water resistance keep it ready for anything. A micro-adjustable bracelet clasp and see-through caseback round out a design built on exploration, craftsmanship, and Baltimore's maritime heritage. watches.name: Bronze Torsk-Diver Pro Polar White
watches.description: The Bronze Torsk-Diver Professional is the newest Diver in the Tsao Baltimore collection and the long awaited followup to the original Torsk-Diver that launched in 2019. Some enhancements include a more refined design, blue BGW9 lume, textured dial, and a Maryland assembled automatic movement called the MD-1. The TORSK-DIVER Professional is named after the USS Torsk submarine, aka SS-423. The USS Torsk was one of ten Tench-class submarines to see service during World War II and happened to sink the last enemy ship in 1945. It has since been decommissioned and is currently being used as a museum ship, managed by the Historic Ships in Baltimore. The Bronze Torsk-Diver Professional is limited to only 423 timepieces.

watches.description: Introducing the VERY Limited Edition Meteorite DLC TORSK-DIVER With a limited quantity of 100 pieces in a surgical grade brushed Steel with a Diamond-Like Carbon Coated (DLC) case, each timepiece will be individually numbered as No. xxx / 100. The TORSK-DIVER is named after the USS Torsk submarine , currently located in the Baltimore Inner Harbor. The USS Torsk was one of ten Tench-class submarines to see service during World War II and happened to sink the last enemy ship in 1945. It has since been decommissioned and is currently being used as a museum ship, managed by the Historic Ships in Baltimore. Features Straps: Includes 3 straps (DLC Bracelet, Black Leather, and Natural Black Rubber) Watch Winder Included Water Resistance: The TORSK-DIVER is tested and rated at 30 ATM / 300m of water resistance. Don't let the looks fool you - the TORSK-DIVER can handle your water adventures. Take it with you when you shower, swim, dive, or surf. The TORSK-DIVER is built like a Submarine... more specifically, like the USS-TORSK. Movement: The automatic Miyota 9015 by Citizen was our number one choice for the TORSK-DIVER. Many reviews have compared it to the Swiss ETA movements in terms of timekeeping and performance without the high price tag. Having used it for our first model, we were extremely pleased with the accuracy and reliability.
